take.title_zh: AI Agent 正式搬進設計畫布
take.title_en: AI Agents Move Onto the Design Canvas
take.body_zh:
Figma 近期更新方向一致：5 月 AI Agent 嵌入畫布協作，6/11 的 Chrome 擴充功能把網頁轉成可編輯圖層，6/12 的個人檔案改版把「人」也整合進畫布生態。

三者都指向同一件事：Figma 想成為素材、工具與身份的單一入口。72% 設計師已用生成式 AI，真正的差異化將落在乾淨的設計系統與檔案結構，讓 agent 能正確延伸。
take.body_en:
Figma's recent updates point in one direction: May's AI agent works directly inside the canvas, June 11's Chrome extension turns any webpage into editable layers, and June 12's profile refresh folds designers' identities into the same ecosystem.

Together, these moves position Figma as a single hub for assets, tools, and identity. With 72% of designers already using generative AI, the real differentiator going forward won't be access to AI—it'll be how cleanly you structure files and design systems so an agent can understand and extend them.

articles.title_zh: Figma Chrome 擴充功能可將網頁轉為可編輯圖層
articles.title_en: Figma's Chrome Extension Turns Webpages Into Editable Layers
articles.summary_zh: Figma 於 6 月 11 日更新 Chrome 擴充功能，讓使用者能把任意網頁的整頁或選取元素，直接擷取進 Figma 畫布並轉換成可編輯的結構化圖層，保留排版、文字與圖片資訊。設計師可藉此快速拆解競品介面、製作 moodboard，或重建現有網站的設計系統，省去手動截圖描圖的時間，對 UX 研究與競品分析工作流程是相當實用的提速工具。
articles.summary_en: Figma updated its Chrome extension on June 11, letting users capture an entire webpage or selected elements and import them into Figma as editable, structured layers that preserve layout, text, and images. This turns competitive teardowns from manual screenshotting and tracing into a one-click import—useful for building moodboards, auditing competitor UIs, or reconstructing an existing site's design system inside Figma's canvas.
articles.take_zh: 把網頁直接變成可編輯圖層，等於把競品分析從截圖描圖變成一鍵匯入，對做 UX audit 或重建設計系統特別省時，但版權與還原精準度仍值得留意。
articles.take_en: Turning any webpage into editable layers collapses competitive teardown work from manual tracing to one click—handy for UX audits and rebuilding design systems fast, though copyright and visual fidelity are worth watching when importing others' work.

articles.title_zh: Figma 推出原生畫布 AI Agent，設計助手直接進駐工作區
articles.title_en: Figma Launches a Canvas-Native AI Agent for Design Tasks
articles.summary_zh: Figma 於 5 月 20 日推出專為設計打造的 AI Agent，直接嵌入畫布協作環境，而非另開漂浮提示框。Agent 能理解既有設計檔案的結構與規範，協助處理重複性的排版、元件替換與規格調整，讓設計師把精力留給更高層次的決策。Figma《2026 設計師現況報告》顯示，已有 72% 的設計師在工作中使用生成式 AI，AI agent 進駐畫布已是明顯走向。
articles.summary_en: Figma launched an AI agent built specifically for design on May 20, embedded directly in its collaborative canvas rather than a separate floating prompt box. The agent understands a file's existing structure and conventions, helping with repetitive tasks like layout adjustments, component swaps, and spec updates so designers can focus on higher-level decisions. Figma's 2026 State of the Designer report found 72% of designers already use generative AI at work, underscoring the shift toward canvas-native agents.
articles.take_zh: AI agent 直接進駐畫布，代表 AI 從「另一個聊天視窗」變成「工作區的一部分」。對設計師來說，重複性工作會持續被吃掉，但對檔案結構與規範的掌握反而更重要。
articles.take_en: Moving the AI agent onto the canvas itself—not a separate chat window—signals that repetitive design tasks will keep getting automated. The skill that matters more now is structuring files and design systems cleanly enough for an agent to understand and extend.

articles.title_zh: Figma 社群個人檔案改版，設計師可展示作品與技能堆疊
articles.title_en: Figma Refreshes Community Profiles to Highlight Skills and Stack
articles.summary_zh: Figma 在 6 月 12 日更新 Community 個人檔案頁面，讓使用者能展示角色、經驗年資與慣用工具堆疊，並以圖片與連結釘選代表作品或常用資源。改版後的個人檔案更像是設計師的迷你作品集與名片，有助於在社群中被其他創作者或招募者發現。對於想透過 Figma Community 累積個人品牌、接案或求職的設計師，是值得花時間更新的一步。
articles.summary_en: Figma refreshed its Community profile pages on June 12, letting members display their role, years of experience, and preferred tool stack, plus pin featured work and resources with images and links. The updated profiles act as a mini-portfolio and business card within Figma's community, making it easier for other creators or recruiters to find a designer's work—worth updating if you're building a personal brand, freelancing, or job-hunting.
articles.take_zh: 把個人檔案變成迷你作品集，等於讓 Figma Community 多了一層求職與接案的能見度；想累積個人品牌的人，值得花十分鐘把資料填齊。
articles.take_en: Turning profiles into mini-portfolios gives Figma Community a hiring and freelance discovery layer—worth ten minutes of setup if you want more visibility for job or client opportunities.
